en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Abi Abdillah, ofALi ibn Muhammed al-Qasani, from the one he mentioned, from Abdullah bin Qasem al-Ju’fi, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said: I heard him say:
The afraid is the one to whom fear did not leave a tongue he can speak with.
